acquisitionStatus.details: Plain HTTP smoke from Docker received 403/cf-mitigated challenge. The vendored scraper now supports stock Playwright Chromium fetching, rendered HTML/network archives, citation-url-map output, URL-manifest section fetching, CSV-derived CONTAINS graph hierarchy, isolated Playwright contexts, and GraphRAG rows with citation_url/source_url fields. Full corpus seeding remains blocked on publisher challenge failures in batch runs.

lastPlaywrightProbe.boundary: No Cloudflare evasion, stealth plugin, captcha solving, proxy rotation, or challenge bypass was used. The probe used a stock Playwright Chromium browser and archived rendered HTML/network proof locally.

lastPlaywrightCliProof.graphUrlProof: section, definition, and graph edge rows include citation_url=https://topeka.municipal.codes/TMC/18.55.010
lastPlaywrightCliProof.dataQualityFix: Ordinance-history extraction now requires a numbered ordinance token and preserves distinct history edges by ordinance/section/date/raw value.

failClosedProof.scenario: Playwright root-only diagnostic crawl fetched pages but extracted zero code sections

vendoredConnector.notes: Adds stock Playwright fetch mode, challenge-only-page detection, rendered HTML/network archive support, citation-url-map output, URL-manifest section fetching, CSV-derived hierarchy graph output, isolated Playwright context mode, GraphRAG citation_url/source_url properties, and operator-owned capture-manifest import.

lastUrlManifestCliProof.boundary: No Cloudflare evasion, stealth plugin, captcha solving, proxy rotation, challenge bypass, ingestion, embedding, Qdrant write, or vector-store write was used. Isolated stock Playwright contexts improved section acquisition but did not make the full corpus seed production-ready.

workbenchProjection.identityPolicy: source_component_key is preserved from Topeka source/graph identity; workbench_component_id is deterministic UUIDv5 from source_component_key.
workbenchProjection.boundary: Projection-only from saved JSON/JSONL/HTML artifacts. No ingestion, vectorization, Qdrant, Postgres, MinIO, OpenSearch, or graph writes.

qualityPolicy.notes: Do not ingest or vectorize additional Topeka codified-code records until JSON artifact coverage, citations, text presence, crawl failures, and graph hierarchy pass.

operatorCaptureManifest.boundary: Accepts operator-owned authorized HTML captures as artifact input. Does not include Cloudflare evasion, stealth plugins, captcha solving, proxy rotation, cookies, credentials, storage state, route secrets, or challenge bypass code.
